arguments.title: INSID3: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation with DINOv3
key_claims: The paper shows spurious cross-image matches at similar coordinates in low-semantic regions and suppresses a positional subspace estimated from noise. This directly motivates dark/flat-background and location controls for DINOv3 in LightSem. Do not automatically remove positional information: it may be useful for within-scene spatial composition, and the paper distinguishes those uses. The method needs a reference mask and handles one concept at a time, so it is not an immediately justified YOLO replacement for multiple moving coaches.
